subject: Mutual Action Plan: Executive sponsor & timelines for Q3 evaluation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stellarisai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan proposal & exec sponsor intro request

Hi Samir —

Great to talk last week. Per our discussion, I’m kicking off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align executive sponsorship, evaluation milestones, and an escalation path so your engineering and security teams can evaluate Redwood in a predictable 6–8 week window.

High-level asks / roles I propose:
- Executive sponsor: Stellais CTO / VP Eng alignment — ideally someone who can unblock procurement and prioritize cross-functional scope (e.g., infra, security, product).
- Day-to-day lead: Marissa Cole (Redwood PM) for runbooks, test plan, and weekly syncs.
- Technical contact: Aditya Rao (solutions engineer) for deployment and performance baseline.
- Security liaison: Neha Kapoor (Redwood security) for SOC2 / data residency questions.

Suggested MAP milestones (draft):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + access (test account, sample data) — target: May 18
2) Week 1–2: Integration + baseline tests (latency, throughput)
3) Week 3: Security review + SOC2 evidence exchange
4) Week 4–5: User acceptance + feature checklist
5) Week 6: Executive review and decision (POC -> pilot / purchase)

Attached is a first-draft MAP spreadsheet that breaks these down into owners and dates (Attachment: Redwood-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx).

Two quick questions for you so we can finalize:
1) Who will be the executive sponsor on the Stellaris side (CTO vs. VP Eng)?
2) Who is the procurement contact for contract & PO timing?

If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute sponsor intro with your execs and our VP of Sales — I’ll propose times once you confirm names.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0219

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear plan and the spreadsheet. I’ve looped in Elena (VP Engineering) and Carlos (Head of Security); Laura from procurement is on cc to help with contracting cadence.

Initial thoughts:
- Exec sponsor: I’m happy to be the technical sponsor, but Elena will be the formal exec sponsor for prioritization and sign-off.
- Procurement: Laura will own timing/PO; she’s asked for a rough cost estimate and a copy of standard T&Cs to start.
- Security: Carlos will coordinate SOC2 evidence; he has questions on log retention and the private deployment option.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sponsor alignment call this Thursday (May 14) at 10:00am PT? If that works, include your VP of Sales; we want exec-to-exec context to cover ramping timelines and escalation paths.
